# Gnomes
Gnomes are small, sweet-toothed tinkerers. They are similar to humans in most respects, however: - They use tools, build, craft and deconstruct 30% faster than other species. - Sugar heals them. With at least 3u of sugar in their system, they slowly heal brute and burn damage. - They are fragile. They take 20% more blunt, slash and piercing damage, and 15% more suffocation damage. - They are small and light. Others can pick them up much faster, while gnomes struggle to carry or pull bigger crewmates. - Their hands are too small for weapons that need both hands. Such a weapon flies out of their grip after the first shot, while pistols are fine. - They speak Gnomish, a clanking tongue full of cogs and sprockets, and their tinkering shows in their accent ("Hullo cogmate!"). - They arrive in their pointy hat and gnome suit. The suit is gnome-sized and fits nobody else.

## Lore
Gnomes are a genetic offshoot of the Human species, created around the same time as the Dwarves. Some believe the first gnomes were simply fascinated by fantasy media, much like the first Dwarves. Others say they were created to help the Space Wizard Federation with its construction efforts. Culturally, gnomes enjoy sweets and gardening, just like their statue cousins.
